## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX falling — VXX (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -22.20%) BELOW TREND — and Stocks vs Bonds rising — SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -1.47%) RECOVERY — confirm risk tilt, while rising credit stress (HYG/LQD) offsets the signal.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND → HYG/LQD ↑ rising. Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -22.20%) BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds showing risk-on tilt: SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-supportive. UUP (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.83%) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve (Level 1.0641) RECOVERY (1W: +0.23% | 1M: -1.89%) point to modest easing, but monitor credit spread (Level 0.7288 ↑).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing breadth strength (Financials 1W: +2.76% | 1M: +10.79%) supporting cyclicals. Style: Growth/Momentum showing leadership on confirmed sector breadth.

5. US vs Global?  
US outperforms but EM participation improving: SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND; EEM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND; China FXI (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -0.97%) RECOVERY but still lagging vs US.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation healthy: IWM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +5.69%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +5.03%) ABOVE TREND; Bitcoin proxy IBIT (1W: +1.54% | 1M: -2.19%) in RECOVERY — nascent risk-on but selective.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Precious metals leadership: PPLT (1W: +18.68% | 1M: +45.37%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +8.23% | 1M: +39.87%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND; base metals CPER (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND supports cyclical demand.

8. Energy Trend?  
Mixed-to-weak: XLE (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +0.37%) CORRECTION, BNO (1W: +2.87% | 1M: -0.93%) RECOVERY, while UNG (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND — watch divergence between oil and gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: TLT (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -1.47%) RECOVERY — short-term bond/long-duration mismatch to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth exposure given XLK, QQQ (QQQ 1W: +4.05% | 1M: +3.23%) ABOVE TREND and semis SOXX (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +8.45%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to long-duration rate sensitivity as TLT RECOVERY and credit stress (HYG/LQD ↑) warrant caution.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +8.45%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +5.97%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLE (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +0.37%) CORRECTION, XLU (1W: +0.87% | 1M: -3.24%) RECOVERY / Utilities showing weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: PPLT (1W: +18.68% | 1M: +45.37%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +8.23% | 1M: +39.87%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND, softening agricultural baskets (WEAT/SOYB mixed).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -22.20%) — watch 20 for complacency. HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: +1.00%) / LQD (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.12%) — HYG/LQD ~0.80 is credit health pivot. Tech/Fin ratio (Tech vs Financials Level 2.6252; Tech/Fin 1W: +0.96% | 1M: -1.84%) — watch ~2.0 for rotation signal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive with VXX falling and SPY above trend but rising credit stress (HYG/LQD) creating mixed signals. Tech and semis showing relative strength — XLK (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +8.45%) ABOVE TREND — key risk is bond/breadth divergence and rising credit stress to monitor.
